question: 促销期净销额占总净销额的比例是多少
sql:
WITH promo_sales AS (
    SELECT SUM(net_amount) AS promo_net
    FROM fact_sales
    WHERE is_promo = TRUE
),
total_sales AS (
    SELECT SUM(net_amount) AS total_net
    FROM fact_sales
)
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN total_net = 0 THEN NULL 
        ELSE promo_net / total_net 
    END AS promo_net_ratio
FROM promo_sales, total_sales

question: 每个大区销量最高的单品是哪个

question: 2026年8月哪些品类的销量比7月增长了

        p.category,

    JOIN dim_product p ON f.sku_id = p.sku_id

question: 各大区净销额及其累计占比，按销额从高到低
sql:
WITH region_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        d.region,
        SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales f
    JOIN dim_outlet d ON f.outlet_id = d.outlet_id
    GROUP BY d.region
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        net_sales,
        SUM(net_sales) OVER (ORDER BY net_sales DESC) AS running_total,
        SUM(net_sales) OVER () AS grand_total
    FROM region_sales
)
SELECT 
    region,
    net_sales,
    running_total / grand_total AS cumulative_ratio
FROM ranked
ORDER BY net_sales DESC

question: 哪些业务代表的有效拜访次数高于平均值

    SELECT 
        r.rep_id,
        r.rep_name,
        COUNT(*) AS visit_count
    FROM fact_visit fv
    JOIN dim_rep r ON fv.rep_id = r.rep_id
    WHERE fv.is_executed = TRUE
    GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.rep_name
),
avg_visits AS (

    FROM rep_visits
)

    WHERE d.year_month = '2025-08'

    c.channel,
    c.current_output - l.last_output AS change_amount,
    (c.current_output - l.last_output) / l.last_output AS change_rate
FROM current_period c
LEFT JOIN last_period l ON c.channel = l.channel

question: 2026年上半年的费效比比2025年下半年高多少
sql:
WITH half_year_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        CASE 
            WHEN d.year = 2025 AND d.month BETWEEN 7 AND 12 THEN '2025H2'
            WHEN d.year = 2026 AND d.month BETWEEN 1 AND 6 THEN '2026H1'
        END AS period,
        SUM(fs.net_amount) AS total_sales,
        SUM(fpc.cost_amount) AS total_promo_cost
    FROM fact_sales fs
    JOIN dim_date d ON fs.date_key = d.date_key
    LEFT JOIN fact_promo_cost fpc ON fs.date_key = fpc.date_key 
        AND fs.outlet_id = fpc.outlet_id 
        AND fs.sku_id = fpc.sku_id 
        AND fs.dealer_id = fpc.dealer_id
    WHERE (d.year = 2025 AND d.month BETWEEN 7 AND 12) 
       OR (d.year = 2026 AND d.month BETWEEN 1 AND 6)
    GROUP BY period
)
SELECT 
    (MAX(CASE WHEN period = '2026H1' THEN total_promo_cost / NULLIF(total_sales, 0) END) -
     MAX(CASE WHEN period = '2025H2' THEN total_promo_cost / NULLIF(total_sales, 0) END)) AS cost_effectiveness_diff
FROM half_year_metrics
